input: How much does the Nimbus Plus plan cost and how much data do I get?

input: Is there a late fee if I pay late?

input: Can I get a refund if I cancel a new plan?
expected_output: Yes. A new plan can be cancelled for a full refund within 14 days of activation.

input: How much is a roaming pass on Nimbus Go?
expected_output: On Nimbus Go, a roaming pass costs $6 per day.
expected_context: Roaming: Roaming is included at no extra cost in 40 countries on Nimbus Plus and Nimbus Max. On Nimbus Go, a roaming pass costs $6 per day. Roaming must be switched on in the Nimbus app before you travel.

input: How long does a replacement SIM take to arrive and what does it cost?
expected_output: A replacement SIM costs $5 and arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
expected_context: SIM cards: A replacement SIM costs $5 and arrives in 3 to 5 business days. An eSIM can be activated instantly in the Nimbus app at no charge. Report a lost or stolen SIM immediately so the line can be blocked.

input: How do I buy a data top-up?
expected_output: You can buy a top-up in the Nimbus app or by texting DATA to 5555. A 5 GB top-up costs $8 and is valid for 30 days.
expected_context: Data top-ups: A data top-up of 5 GB costs $8 and is valid for 30 days. Top-ups can be bought in the Nimbus app or by texting DATA to 5555. Unused top-up data does not roll over.

input: Is there a fee for cancelling a 12-month contract early?
expected_output: Yes. Cancelling a 12-month contract early costs $10 for each remaining month.
expected_context: Cancelling a plan: You can cancel a plan at any time with 30 days notice. There is no cancellation fee on monthly plans. Cancelling a 12-month contract early costs $10 for each remaining month.
